string.ID: Your new pet is ready to love.

strings.string: 你的新寵物已準備好與你建立感情。
正在重新啟動應用程式...

string.ID: You should view the tooltip before equipping the axe.

strings.string: 在裝備這把斧頭之前，你應該先查看工具提示。

string.ID: Huh, you somehow destroyed the battle axe. Let's move on.

strings.string: 哼，你竟然毀掉了戰斧。我們繼續吧。

string.ID: The battle axe has better penetration and deals more damage than your dagger.

strings.string: 戰斧比你的匕首擁有更好的穿透力，且造成的傷害更高。

string.ID:
Let's take another look at weapon stats. Next to the {{c|→}} is 5. That means you'll usually penetrate the armor of a creature with AV equal to 5.
You can penetrate armor multiple times, though, and each time you penetrate, you deal the weapon's damage.
Let's equip it.
string.Value:
讓我們再看一下武器屬性。{{c|→}} 旁邊的數字是 5。這代表你通常可以穿透護甲值 (AV) 等於 5 的生物護甲。
不過，你可以多次穿透護甲，每次穿透時都會造成該武器的傷害。
讓我們裝備它。

string.ID:
A battle axe. Get it.
Hit =commandKey:CmdUse=
string.Value:
一把戰斧。拿走它。
按下 =commandKey:CmdUse=

string.ID:
A battle axe. Get it.
Hit =commandKey:CmdGet=
string.Value:
一把戰斧。拿走它。
擊中 =commandKey:CmdGet=

string.ID: Looks like there was some sort of battle to the north. Let's grab the gear that was left behind.

strings.string: 北邊似乎發生過某種戰鬥。我們把留下的裝備撿起來吧。

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdCharacter=
string.Value:
讓我們來看看裝備畫面。
按下 =commandKey:CmdCharacter=

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdEquipment=
string.Value:
讓我們來看看裝備畫面。
按下 =commandKey:CmdEquipment=

string.ID: Hold on, we want to show you the tooltip compare feature.

strings.string: 稍等一下，我們想向您展示工具提示比較功能。

string.ID: Press =commandKey:GamepadAlt= + =commandKey:Take A Step= to view the tooltip.

strings.string: 按下 =commandKey:GamepadAlt= + =commandKey:Take A Step= 以查看工具提示。

string.ID: Mouse over the battle axe and hover or press {{W|Alt}} to view the tooltip.

strings.string: 你會放棄你的職責，並發誓不再騷擾這個世界的生物嗎？

string.ID: Equip the battle axe since it's better than your dagger.

strings.string: 裝備戰斧吧，因為它比你的匕首更好用。

string.ID:
Select the Inventory && Equipment tab.
You can use =commandKey:Page Left= and =commandKey:Page Right= to navigate between tabs.
string.Value:
選擇「物品欄與裝備」分頁。
您可以使用 =commandKey:Page Left= 與 =commandKey:Page Right= 在各個分頁之間切換。

string.ID:
The bear is dead! Looks like it dropped something, too.
But first, let's use this opportunity to heal.
string.Value:
熊死了！看起來它還掉落了某些東西。
但首先，讓我們利用這個機會進行治療。

string.ID:
You regain hitpoints naturally as turns pass. You can pass a few turns by waiting, or if there are no hostile creatures around, you can {{W|rest until healed}}.
Press =commandKey:CmdWaitUntilHealed=
string.Value:
隨著回合流逝，你會自然地恢復生命值。你可以透過等待來跳過幾個回合，或者如果周圍沒有敵對生物，你可以 {{W|休息直到痊癒}}。
按下 =commandKey:CmdWaitUntilHealed=

string.ID: It's a chem cell. It can be used later to power other artifacts you find.

strings.string: 這是一個化學電池。稍後可以用來為你發現的其他神器提供動力。

string.ID:
You picked up the odd trinket automatically because it is an artifact.
Press =commandKey:CmdCharacter= to investigate it.
string.Value:
你自動拾取了這個奇特小玩意，因為它是一件神器。
按下 =commandKey:CmdCharacter= 來調查它。

string.ID:
You picked up the odd trinket automatically because it is an artifact.
Press =commandKey:CmdInventory= to investigate it.
string.Value:
你自動拾取了這個奇特小玩意，因為它是一件神器。
按下 =commandKey:CmdInventory= 來調查它。

string.ID: The bear is dead! Looks like it dropped something, too.

strings.string: 熊死了！看起來它還掉落了某樣東西。

string.ID: This is an artifact beyond simple understanding. Try examining it.

strings.string: 這是一件超越常理理解的神器。試著檢查它看看。

string.ID:
Select the Inventory && Equipment tab.
You can use =commandKey:Page Left= and =commandKey:Page Right= to navigate between tabs.
string.Value:
選擇「物品欄與裝備」分頁。
您可以使用 =commandKey:Page Left= 與 =commandKey:Page Right= 在各個分頁之間切換。

string.ID: The whole game world is a series of contiguous maps. Our passage continues off screen. Let's follow it. Walk north.

strings.string: 整個遊戲世界是由一系列相連的地圖組成的。我們的旅程會持續在螢幕之外。讓我們跟隨它吧。向北走。

string.ID:
Oh! it looks like Warden Yrame killed Mehmet. Why, you ask?
Well, named creatures who you can perform the water ritual with, like Mehmet, generate with dynamic faction relationships. In your game, Mehmet must have been hated by the 守望者同盟(Fellowship of Wardens) for some reason.
string.Value:
喔！看起來 Warden 伊萊姆 殺死了 梅赫梅特。你問為什麼？
嗯，像 梅赫梅特 這樣可以進行 水之儀式 的命名生物，在生成時會帶有動態的派系關係。在你的遊戲中，梅赫梅特 可能是因為某些原因而被 守護者同盟 所憎恨。

string.ID:
And so Warden Yrame took her revenge. In Qud, sometimes even our best efforts at providing a safe starter village are foiled by the simulation!
What a charmed run! It's quite rare for this to happen, but now you get to see this hidden section of the tutorial. Good job.
string.Value:
於是 Warden 伊萊姆 完成了她的復仇。在 卡德(Qud)，有時即使我們竭盡全力提供安全的初始村莊，也會被模擬系統所挫敗！
多麼幸運的一場遊戲！這種情況非常罕見，但現在你可以看到教學課程中這段隱藏內容。做得好。

string.ID:
You have a few options now. You can roll with it and continue in this world where Mehmet's been revenge-slain. The early game will be a bit harder, but the main quest is not impacted.
You can start over and play the tutorial again, for the "normal" ending, which you were about to reach.
Or, since you were near the end anyway, you can start a new game and begin your journey proper!
string.Value:
你現在有幾個選擇。你可以順應現狀，在這個梅赫梅特已被復仇殺死的世界上繼續下去。遊戲前期會稍微困難一些，但主線任務不會受到影響。
你可以重新開始並再次進行教學課程，以達成你原本即將達成的「正常」結局。
或者，既然你本來就快結束了，你可以開啟新遊戲，正式展開你的旅程！

string.ID:
Whatever you choose, good luck, and feel free to return here for a refresher.
Live and drink.
string.Value:
無論你做出什麼選擇，祝你好運，歡迎隨時回來重新整理狀態。
生存並飲酒。

string.ID:
Quetzal! That's all for the tutorial, friend.
We just scratched the very tip of the surface. Quests, secrets, leveling up, physics, reputation, limbs... we leave that for you to discover.
string.Value:
Quetzal！教學到此結束，朋友。
我們才剛觸及皮毛而已。任務、秘密、升級、物理機制、聲望、肢體……這些都留給你去發現。

string.ID: You're ready to continue the journey on your own, but don't hesitate to play the tutorial again if you need a refresher.

strings.string: 你已準備好獨自繼續旅程，但如果需要複習，請隨時重新進行教學模式。

string.ID: 約帕(Joppa) is a village. Everything you learned in the cave applies here too. Villages are like caves with very high roofs.

strings.string: 約帕是一個村莊。你在洞窟中所學到的一切也同樣適用於此。村莊就像是擁有極高屋頂的洞窟。

string.ID:
You can see a list of points of interest by pressing =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest=.
The list will grow as you explore more of the map.
string.Value:
按下 =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest= 可查看興趣點列表。
隨著你探索更多地圖，該列表會不斷增長。

string.ID:
You can see a list of points of interest by clicking this button or pressing =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest=.
The list will grow as you explore more of the map.
string.Value:
點擊此按鈕或按下 =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest= 可以查看興趣點列表。
隨著你探索更多地圖，該列表會不斷增加。

上升。
按下 =commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

string.ID:
Ascend.
You can click this button or press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.
string.Value:
上升。
你可以點擊此按鈕或按下 =commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

string.ID: Finally, a staircase. Walk over to it.

strings.string: 終於看到樓梯了。走過去吧。

string.ID:
You'll be able to explore the world freely after the tutorial.
For now, let's visit 約帕(Joppa).
string.Value:
教學結束後，你就能自由地探索世界。
現在，讓我們先去參訪 約帕(Joppa)。

string.ID:
You can look around here just like on a local map.
Use =commandKey:LookDirection=
string.Value:
你可以像在局部地圖上一樣觀察此處。
使用 =commandKey:LookDirection=

string.ID:
You can look around here just like on a local map.
Press =commandKey:CmdLook=
string.Value:
你可以像查看區域地圖一樣在此觀察四周。
按下 =commandKey:CmdLook=

下降。
按下 =commandKey:CmdMoveD=。

string.ID:
Descend.
You can click this button or press =commandKey:CmdMoveD=.
string.Value:
下降。
你可以點擊此按鈕或按下 =commandKey:CmdMoveD=。

string.ID:
There's a village to the north called 約帕(Joppa). Let's go there.
Hold =commandKey:IndicateDirection= towards the north and press =commandKey:Take A Step=.
string.Value:
北邊有一個名為 約帕(Joppa) 的村莊。我們去那裡吧。
朝北方向按住 =commandKey:IndicateDirection= 並按下 =commandKey:Take A Step=。

string.ID:
There's a village to the north called 約帕(Joppa). Let's go there.
Press =commandKey:CmdMoveN= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=.
string.Value:
北邊有一個叫做 約帕(Joppa) 的村莊。我們去那裡吧。
按下 =commandKey:CmdMoveN= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=。

string.ID: Wait for the bear to take a step towards you.
Make sure the bear is in the path of your freezing ray.

strings.string: 確保熊位於你的冰凍射線路徑上。

string.ID: What's that??? Some sort of creature. Take a closer look at it.

strings.string: 那是什麼？？？某種生物。仔細觀察它。

string.ID: It's quite dangerous to fight this bear in melee combat! Try backing away and using Freezing Ray.

strings.string: 近身戰鬥這隻熊相當危險！試著退後並使用冰凍射線（Freezing Ray）。

string.ID: Let's take a look at the bear before we continue.

strings.string: 在繼續之前，我們先來看看那隻熊吧。

string.ID:
Oh! Another creature. Let's look at it more closely.
When you come across something new, it's always a good idea to inspect it.
string.Value:
喔！又是另一個生物。讓我們仔細觀察一下。
當你遇到新奇的事物時，仔細檢查總是個好主意。

string.ID: The bear is wounded, but it's tough. This'll be a harder fight.

strings.string: 熊受傷了，但它很強韌。這將會是一場更艱苦的戰鬥。

string.ID: Use =commandKey:LookDirection= to look at the bear.

strings.string: 使用 =commandKey:LookDirection= 來觀察那隻熊。

string.ID:
Look view lets you look around and investigate your surroundings.
Move the cursor to the bear.
string.Value:
觀察視角讓你可以環顧四周並調查周遭環境。
將游標移至熊身上。

string.ID:
You can wait a turn for the bear to approach. That way, it won't be in range to attack you when it takes its turn.
Tap =commandKey:Take A Step= without choosing a direction with the stick to pass a turn.
string.Value:
您可以等待一回合讓熊靠近。這樣當它輪到回合時，就不會在攻擊範圍內。
在不使用搖桿選擇方向的情況下點擊 =commandKey:Take A Step= 即可跳過回合。

string.ID:
You can wait a turn for the bear to approach. That way, it won't be in range to attack you when it takes its turn.
Press =commandKey:CmdWait:allbinds= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction= on your character to pass a turn.
string.Value:
您可以等待一個回合讓熊靠近。這樣一來，當它輪到回合時，就不會在攻擊範圍內。
對您的角色按下 =commandKey:CmdWait:allbinds= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction= 來跳過回合。

string.ID:
You missed, then the bear attacked and missed.
Attack again.
string.Value:
你沒打中，接著熊發動了攻擊但也不中。
再次嘗試攻擊。

string.ID:
This time you hit, but you failed to penetrate the bear's armor.
Then, the bear hit you and DID penetrate your armor. You took 4 damage.
string.Value:
這次您擊中了，但未能穿透熊的護甲。
隨後，熊擊中了您，並且「成功」穿透了您的護甲。您受到了 4 點傷害。

string.ID:
Let's try using an ability. Look at your ability bar. Let's start sprinting.
Select it with =commandKey:Next Ability= and =commandKey:Previous Ability= then press =commandKey:Use Ability=.
string.Value:
讓我們試著使用一項能力吧。看看你的能力列。讓我們開始衝刺。
使用 =commandKey:Next Ability= 與 =commandKey:Previous Ability= 進行選擇，然後按下 =commandKey:Use Ability=。

string.ID: Let's try using an ability. Look at your ability bar. Let's start sprinting. You can click the button or hit the hotkey =commandKey:CmdAbility1=.

strings.string: 讓我們試著使用能力。看看你的能力列。讓我們開始衝刺吧。你可以點擊按鈕或按下熱鍵 =commandKey:CmdAbility1=。

string.ID: Sprinting doubles your movespeed but ends if you make an attack. Let's sprint back down the corridor to put some distance between us and the bear.

strings.string: 衝刺會使你的移動速度翻倍，但一旦發動攻擊就會停止。讓我們衝回走廊，與那隻熊拉開距離。

string.ID:
Every character has Sprint, but most of your abilities are determined by traits like your mutations. You have Freezing Ray, so you can shoot frost out of your hands.
Select it with =commandKey:Next Ability= and =commandKey:Previous Ability= then press =commandKey:Use Ability=.
string.Value:
每個角色都有衝刺能力，但你的大部分能力是由特質（例如突變）決定的。你擁有冰凍射線，因此可以從手中射出寒霜。
使用 =commandKey:Next Ability= 與 =commandKey:Previous Ability= 進行選擇，然後按下 =commandKey:Use Ability=。

string.ID:
Every character has Sprint, but most of your abilities are determined by traits like your mutations. You have Freezing Ray, so you can shoot frost out of your hands. Select it.
Press =commandKey:CmdAbility2=
string.Value:
每個角色都有「衝刺」(Sprint)，但大部分的能力是由突變等特質決定的。您擁有「冰凍射線」(Freezing Ray)，因此可以從手中射出寒霜。請選擇它。
按下 =commandKey:CmdAbility2=

string.ID: What's that??? Some sort of creature. Take a closer look at it.

strings.string: 那是什麼？？？某種生物。仔細觀察它。

string.ID: Before you move on, you should loot the corpse of the snapjaw.

strings.string: 在繼續前進之前，你應該搜刮 咬顎獸 的屍體。

string.ID: Take a look at the snapjaw before we continue.

strings.string: 在我們繼續之前，先看看那隻咬顎獸。

string.ID: Huh, you somehow destroyed the leather armor. Let's move on.

strings.string: 哼，你竟然把 皮革護甲 給毀了。我們繼續吧。

string.ID: Let's explore further into the cave.

strings.string: 讓我們往洞穴深處探索吧。

string.ID:
Let's explore further into the cave.
Walk down the passage.
string.Value:
讓我們往洞穴深處探索。
沿著通道向下走。

string.ID: Looking at a creature shows its description and some other important details. Every object in the world can be looked at.

strings.string: 查看生物可以顯示其描述與其他重要細節。世界上的每個物品都可以被查看。

string.ID: The snapjaw is hostile! Let's get ready for a fight.

strings.string: 咬顎獸具有敵意！準備戰鬥。

string.ID: Use =commandKey:LookDirection= to look at the snapjaw.

strings.string: 使用 =commandKey:LookDirection= 來觀察 咬顎獸。
按下 =commandKey:CmdLook= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract= 來觀察咬顎獸。

string.ID: Here we have a description of the creature, along with some details about them.

strings.string: 這裡有關於該生物的描述，以及一些關於牠們的細節。

string.ID: The snapjaw is hostile! Let's get ready for a fight.

strings.string: 咬顎獸具有敵意！準備戰鬥。

string.ID:
Look view lets you look around and investigate your surroundings.
Move the cursor to the snapjaw.
string.Value:
觀察視角讓你可以環顧四周並調查周遭環境。
將游標移至 咬顎獸。

string.ID:
All actions are turn-based, meaning you take a turn, then other creatures take a turn. For the most part, creatures won't act until you do.
If you ever get panicked, just slow down and consider your next move. There's no rush.
string.Value:
所有行動皆為回合制，這意味著您進行一個回合後，其他生物才會進行一個回合。在大多數情況下，生物在您行動前不會採取行動。
如果您感到恐慌，只需放慢節奏並思考您的下一步。不必著急。

string.ID: You can attack a hostile creature by moving into its square. This is called {{W|bump attacking}}.

strings.string: 你可以透過移動到敵對生物所在的格子來進行攻擊。這被稱為{{W|撞擊攻擊}}。

string.ID: Take a step toward the snapjaw.

strings.string: 向著 咬顎獸 邁進一步。

string.ID:
You can pick up things that are in the same space as you.
Press =commandKey:CmdUse=
string.Value:
你可以撿起位於你所在位置的物品。
按下 =commandKey:CmdUse=

string.ID:
You can pick up things that are in the same space as you.
Press =commandKey:CmdGet=
string.Value:
你可以撿起位於你所在位置的物品。
按下 =commandKey:CmdGet=

string.ID:
Whew! You killed the snapjaw and earned some experience. It looks like they dropped a piece of equipment, too.
Press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction.
string.Value:
呼！你殺死了咬顎獸並獲得了一些經驗值。看起來牠們也掉落了一件裝備。
按下 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= 然後選擇一個方向。

string.ID:
Whew! You killed the snapjaw and earned some experience. It looks like they dropped a piece of equipment, too.
Press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction or press =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract=.
string.Value:
呼！你殺死了 咬顎獸 並獲得了一些經驗值。看起來牠們也掉落了一件裝備。
按下 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= 然後選擇一個方向，或按下 =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract=。

string.ID:
Let's look at the leather armor you picked up.
Armor has an armor value (=av:2=) and a dodge value (=dv:0=)
Both help you avoid damage.
string.Value:
讓我們看看你撿到的皮革護甲。
護甲具有護甲值 (=av:2=) 與閃避值 (=dv:0=)
兩者皆有助於你避免傷害。

string.ID: It's leather armor. This time, get it instead of equipping it.

strings.string: 這是 皮革護甲。這次直接把它收起來，而不是裝備它。

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdCharacter=
string.Value:
讓我們來看看裝備畫面。
按下 =commandKey:CmdCharacter=

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdEquipment=
string.Value:
讓我們來看看裝備畫面。
按下 =commandKey:CmdEquipment=

string.ID: This is your equipment and inventory screen. Equipped items on the left, and inventory on the right.

strings.string: 這是你的裝備與物品欄介面。左側為已裝備物品，右側為物品欄。

string.ID:
You can also equip items by dragging them from your inventory to their equipment slot.
By the way, you have several other tabs in your character sheet. Feel free to explore them later.
string.Value:
你也可以透過將物品從背包拖曳到裝備欄位來進行裝備。
順帶一提，你的角色面板還有其他幾個分頁，歡迎稍後再自行探索。

string.ID:
Select the Inventory && Equipment tab.
You can use =commandKey:Page Left= and =commandKey:Page Right= to navigate between tabs.
string.Value:
選擇「物品欄與裝備」分頁。
您可以使用 =commandKey:Page Left= 與 =commandKey:Page Right= 在各個分頁之間切換。

string.ID:
Sometimes squares have multiple items in them.
To see everything in a space, press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction.
string.Value:
有時格子內會有多件物品。
若要查看某個空間內的所有東西，請按下 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= 然後選擇一個方向。

string.ID:
Sometimes squares have multiple items in them.
To see everything in a space, press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction or press =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteractAll=.
string.Value:
有時格子內會有多個物品。
若要查看空間內的所有物品，請按 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= 然後選擇一個方向，或按 =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteractAll=。

string.ID:
Whoever this was, they had some books. All books can be read in game.
Books with {{Y|white}} titles are generated and usually contain nonsense, but the nonsense can occasionally be useful.
Books with {{W|gold}} titles are more valuable: they are handwritten by in-world beings and contain interesting takes on the world.
string.Value:
無論這原本是誰，他們都擁有一些書。遊戲中所有的書都可以閱讀。
標題為 {{Y|白色}} 的書是隨機生成的，通常內容毫無意義，但這些胡言亂語偶爾也會派上用場。
標題為 {{W|金色}} 的書更有價值：它們是由遊戲世界中的生物親手撰寫，包含了對這個世界有趣的見解。

string.ID: This water is valuable too. Take it all.

strings.string: 這水也很珍貴。全部拿走吧。

string.ID:
Welcome to the Caves of Qud tutorial. We'll just be scratching the surface here, learning enough of the basics to help you get your footing.
In Caves of Qud, you play as a mutated human or true kin.
For the tutorial, we're picking mutated human.
string.Value:
歡迎來到 卡德洞窟 教學。我們這裡只會略作介紹，學習足夠的基本知識來幫助你站穩腳跟。
在 卡德洞窟 中，你扮演的是 突變人類 或 真人類。
在本次教學中，我們選擇 突變人類。

string.ID:
Character creation is a deep and sometimes long process. We included some preset builds to help you get started. After the tutorial, you can try another build, or make a character from scratch. (The recommended way! Once you get your footing.)
For now, pick the marsh taur.
string.Value:
角色創建是一個深入且有時漫長的過程。我們包含了一些預設配置以幫助你入門。在教學結束後，你可以嘗試其他配置，或從頭開始創建角色。（推薦做法！一旦你站穩腳跟後。）
目前，請選擇沼澤牛頭人 (marsh taur)。

string.ID: Here is a summary of your attributes and mutations, which grant your character unique abilities.

strings.string: 這是您的屬性與突變摘要，它們賦予您的角色獨特的能力。

string.ID: You can name your character or choose Next for a random name.

strings.string: 您可以為角色命名，或選擇「下一步」以獲得隨機名稱。

string.ID: On the 30th of Kisu Ux, you scuttle down a dark shaft at the edge of a sunken trade path and arrive at a caravanserai. It's powdered in salt and dust from across the ribbon of time.

strings.string: 在 Kisu Ux 月的 30 日，你沿著沉沒貿易路邊緣的一個黑暗豎井爬行而下，抵達了一處商隊驛站。那裡佈滿了來自時間絲帶各處的鹽粉與塵埃。

string.ID: We're on the surface now. We can walk the whole world this way, or we can access the worldmap to fast travel.

strings.string: 我們現在在地面上了。我們可以這樣走遍整個世界，或者也可以透過世界地圖進行快速旅行。

string.ID: But first, you just became hungry. You need to eat.

strings.string: 但首先，你感到肚子餓了。你需要進食。

string.ID: Let's make camp. How about next to that beetle over there.

strings.string: 我們紮營吧。就在那隻甲蟲旁邊如何？

string.ID:
Let's not be rude. Talk to the beetle.
Press =commandKey:CmdUse=.
string.Value:
別沒禮貌。跟甲蟲說話。
按下 =commandKey:CmdUse=。

string.ID:
Let's not be rude. Talk to the beetle.
Press =commandKey:CmdUse= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=.
string.Value:
別這麼沒禮貌。跟甲蟲說話。
按下 =commandKey:CmdUse= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=。

string.ID: Let's not be rude. Talk to the beetle.

strings.string: 別沒禮貌。跟那隻甲蟲說話。

string.ID:
Not much of a talker. But that's not true for everyone. As long as a creature isn't hostile, you can try to chat with them.
Let's see what the beetle has for trade.
string.Value:
不太愛說話。但並非對所有人都是如此。只要生物不是敵對狀態，你就可以嘗試與他們交談。
來看看這隻甲蟲有什麼可以交易的。

string.ID:
The beetle's inventory is on the left, and your inventory is on the right.
The beetle has some witchwood bark. That's useful — it heals you when you eat it. Let's trade for it.
string.Value:
甲蟲的物品欄在左側，您的物品欄在右側。
甲蟲有一些巫木皮。這很有用——吃掉它可以治療你。讓我們來交易吧。

string.ID:
The beetle has some witchwood bark. That's useful — it heals you when you eat it. Let's trade for it.
Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=
string.Value:
這隻甲蟲身上有一些巫木皮（witchwood bark）。這很有用——吃掉它能治療你。我們來交易吧。
按下 =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=

string.ID:
The beetle has some witchwood bark. That's useful — it heals you when you eat it. Let's trade for it.
Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=
string.Value:
甲蟲有一些巫木皮。這很有用——吃掉它可以治療你。讓我們來交易吧。
請按 =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=

string.ID:
We don't need this dagger any more, so we can trade it away.
Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=
string.Value:
我們不再需要這把匕首了，所以可以把它交易掉。
按下 =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=

string.ID:
We don't need this dagger any more, so we can trade it away.
Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=
string.Value:
我們不再需要這把匕首了，所以可以把它交易掉。
按下 =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=

string.ID:
The trade is uneven, so we'll have to pony up some money.
In the salt-stippled ecosystem of Qud, {{B|fresh water}} is currency. You need to drink it, too, so don't spend it all.
string.Value:
這次交易並不對等，所以我們得付一些錢。
在卡德那佈滿鹽粒的生態系統中，{{B|淡水}} 就是貨幣。你也需要飲用它，所以別把它全部花光。

string.ID:
Now to go to the world map. Try ascending again.
Press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.
string.Value:
現在前往世界地圖。再次嘗試上升。
按下 =commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

string.ID:
Now to go to the world map. Try ascending again.
You can click this button or press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.
string.Value:
現在前往世界地圖。嘗試再次上升。
你可以點擊此按鈕或按下 =commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

string.ID: Before you move on, you should equip yourself from the nearby chest.

strings.string: 在繼續前進之前，你應該先從附近的箱子中裝備好自己。

string.ID:
This is the main gameplay stage. At the top of the screen are your attributes, HP, and XP.
On the right are action buttons, minimap, and the message log.
At the bottom is your ability hotbar.
string.Value:
這是主要的遊戲畫面。螢幕上方顯示您的屬性、HP 與 XP。
右側是動作按鈕、小地圖與訊息紀錄。
底部是您的技能快捷列。

string.ID: Let's explore this cave we've found ourselves in.

strings.string: 讓我們探索一下我們誤入的這個洞穴。

string.ID:
Huh, you destroyed the tutorial chest we were going to teach you how to use.
Go ahead and pick of the torch and dagger from the floor.
string.Value:
哼，你把我們正要教你如何使用的教學箱子給毀掉了。
從地板上撿起火把和匕首吧。

string.ID: A torch. When it's nighttime or when you're underground, you need a torch equipped to see. Select it.

strings.string: 火把。在夜晚或身處地下時，你需要裝備火把才能看清。請選擇它。

string.ID:
You can interact with objects you're next to. Open the chest.
Press =commandKey:Accept=
string.Value:
你可以與身旁的物品互動。打開箱子。
按下 =commandKey:Accept=

string.ID:
You can interact with objects you're next to. Open the chest.
Press =commandKey:Accept= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=
string.Value:
你可以與身旁的物品互動。打開箱子。
按下 =commandKey:Accept= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=

string.ID:
Looks like there's a chest over at the end of the room. Let's walk over to it.
Hold =commandKey:IndicateDirection= in the direction you want to move and press =commandKey:Take A Step=.
string.Value:
房間盡頭似乎有一個箱子。我們走過去看看吧。
按住 =commandKey:IndicateDirection= 並朝你想要移動的方向，然後按下 =commandKey:Take A Step=。

房間盡頭似乎有一個寶箱。讓我們走過去看看吧。
你可以點擊 =commandKey:AdventureNavMouseLeftClick= 你想要移動到的方格，或者使用 {{hotkey|方向鍵}} 或 {{hotkey|數字鍵}}。
使用方向鍵時，你可以按 {{hotkey|shift+方向鍵}} 來進行對角線移動。

string.ID: We're not quite ready to leave yet.

string.ID: =spice:commonPhrases.celebrate.!random|capitalize= the =spice:commonPhrases.sacred.!random= =yearName=, when =spice.entity:name= was dowered with the =maskName= and named sultan of Qud! =spice.entity:possessivePronoun|capitalize= ancestors the Fossilized Saads looked on in approval, since -- just like them -- =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= was known by =spice.entity:possessivePronoun= =sultanKnownFor=.

strings.string: =spice:commonPhrases.celebrate.!random|capitalize= =yearName= 那個 =spice:commonPhrases.sacred.!random= 的年份，當時 =spice.entity:name= 被賜予了 =maskName= 並被封為卡德的蘇丹！=spice.entity:possessivePronoun|capitalize= 祖先們——化石化的薩德家族（Fossilized Saads）——都欣慰地注視著，因為——就像他們一樣——=spice.entity:subjectPronoun= 也以 =spice.entity:possessivePronoun= =sultanKnownFor= 而聞名。

string.ID: =spice:commonPhrases.remember.!random|capitalize= the lesson that =spice.entity:name= taught =spice.entity:possessivePronoun= advisors when they suggested =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= abdicate the throne =afterTumultuousYears=. Did =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= do any such thing? No! Instead, =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= =countered=.

strings.string: =spice:commonPhrases.remember.!random|capitalize= =spice.entity:name= 在建議 =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= 讓 =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= abdicate the 王座 =afterTumultuousYears= 時，教給 =spice.entity:possessivePronoun= 顧問們的教訓。=spice.entity:subjectPronoun= 有做過那樣的事嗎？沒有！相反地，=spice.entity:subjectPronoun= =countered=。

string.ID: =spice:commonPhrases.oneStarryNight.!random|capitalize= in =spice.entity:region=, a healthy child was born to the sultan at =spice.entity:location=. At the moment of =spice.entity:possessivePronoun= birth, =miracle=, and in celebration the people =spice:commonPhrases.celebrated.!random=. The babe was named =spice.entity:name=, but the people called =spice.entity:objectPronoun= =cognomen=.

strings.string: 在 =spice.entity:region=，=spice:commonPhrases.oneStarryNight.!random|capitalize= 時，蘇丹在 =spice.entity:location= 生下了一個健康的孩童。就在 =spice.entity:possessivePronoun= 出生的那一刻，=miracle= 降臨了，為了慶祝，人們 =spice:commonPhrases.celebrated.!random=. 這名嬰兒被命名為 =spice.entity:name=，但人們稱呼 =spice.entity:objectPronoun= 為 =cognomen=.

string.ID: =spice:commonPhrases.onlooker.!random|capitalize=! =spice:instancesOf.observeInWonder.!random|capitalize= the life of =spice.entity:name= -- called =cognomen=! -- scion of the Fossilized Saads and who was dowered the =maskName=. Observe the twin miracles of the =yearName=: the =male.if:heir:heiress= was born, and =miracle|giveFamousPersonAName=.
string.p: =spice:commonPhrases.onlooker.!random|capitalize=! =spice:instancesOf.observeInWonder.!random|capitalize= 了 =spice.entity:name= 的一生 —— 被稱為 =cognomen=! —— 他是化石化薩德（Fossilized Saads）的後裔，並獲賜了 =maskName=。目睹 =yearName= 年的雙重奇蹟：=male.if:heir:heiress= 出生，以及 =miracle|giveFamousPersonAName=。

string.ID: 蜷曲羔羊教派(Cult of the Coiled Lamb)

In %=year=%, Rebekah died of glotrot, and on her deathbed Resheph forgave her and absolved her of sin. He allowed her to be buried in the village of 以斯拉(Ezra), outside the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters and beneath the shadow of the 紡錘(Spindle).

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，Rebekah 死於黏液腐爛症（glotrot），她在臨終前獲得了 Resheph 的寬恕與赦免。他允許她葬在以斯拉村，位於食者之墓大門外，並在紡錘的陰影之下。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph appointed Rebekah administrator of =region=. She tendered alms for the sick in his name.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，Resheph 任命 Rebekah 為 =region= 的管理員。她以他的名義向病人施捨救濟。

string.ID: Acting against a prohibition on the practice of worshipping the stars, Resheph led an army to the gates of 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch). There he defeated his brothers in battle and liberated its citizens, and they crowned him the sultan of Qud.

strings.string: Resheph 因違反禁止崇拜星辰的禁令，率領軍隊前往歐蒙波奇之門。他在戰鬥中擊敗了他的兄弟們並解放了當地的公民，他們擁立他為卡德的蘇丹。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Rebekah betrayed Resheph by stealing the Mark of Death from the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters. In punishment, Resheph excommunicated her from the sultanate.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，Rebekah 因為從吞噬者之墓的門口偷走了死亡印記而背叛了Resheph。作為懲罰，Resheph 將她從蘇丹國中逐出了教籍。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph cleansed the marshlands of the plagues of the 環流(Gyre) and taught Abram to sow watervine along its fertile tracks.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，雷舍夫（Resheph）淨化了沼澤地中的 環流(Gyre) 之瘟疫，並教導亞伯拉罕（Abram）沿著肥沃的痕跡種植 水藤。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph closed the gates to the Tomb of the Eaters, abdicated the throne, and dissolved the sultanate in order to lift the curse of the 環流(Gyre).

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，Resheph 關閉了食者之墓的大門，退出了 王座，並解散了蘇丹國，以解除 環流(Gyre) 的詛咒。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph, the Above, Ghost-in-Cerulean, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls, died of natural causes. He was 216 years old.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 中，Resheph，至高者、青藍之魂、Baetyls 的捲曲羔羊，死於自然原因。他享年 216 歲。

string.ID: After conferring with mysterious strangers, Resheph convinced them to help him found a harborage for the purpose of receiving visitors from across the clustered cosmos. They named it Starfarer's Quay.

strings.string: 在與 神秘陌生人 商議後，Resheph 說服他們協助他建立一個避風港，目的是接待來自集群宇宙各處的訪客。他們將其命名為 星行者碼頭。

string.ID: While traveling alone through the Rust Wells, Resheph came across a trove of gleaming stars in a bottle. From that day forth, he always kept some stardust on his person.

strings.string: 當獨自穿梭於 鏽蝕之井 時，Resheph 在一個 瓶子 中發現了一堆閃爍的星辰。從那天起，他總是隨身帶著一些星塵。

string.ID: In %=year=%, the 環流(Gyre) widened, and the first triad of plagues afflicted the land. The water was poisoned with salt, girshlings ravaged the fruit and wheat, and tongues rotted away in the mouths of kith and kin. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.

strings.string: 在 %=year=%，旋渦（環流(Gyre)）擴張了，第一波三位一體的瘟疫襲擊了大地。水源被鹽分毒害，小魚精（girshlings）蹂躪著果實與小麥，親友們的舌頭在口中腐爛。雷舍夫（Resheph）走在鉻合金拱門之下，醫治了病人。

string.ID: In %=year=%, the 環流(Gyre) widened, and the second triad of plagues afflicted the land. The legs of kith and kin annealed to iron, darkness bloomed from the earth, and the svardym blackened the sky. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，環流擴張了，第二波瘟疫災難襲擊了大地。親友的肢體與血脈被鍛造成鐵，黑暗從土地中綻放，而斯瓦迪姆遮蔽了天空。Resheph 在鉻色拱門下行走，治癒了病人。

string.ID: One starry evening, a babe was found swaddled with its mouth full of circuits by a group of baetyls in Red Rock. They took him into their fold and fostered him, and he became known as Resheph, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls.

strings.string: 在一個星光熠熠的夜晚，一群在紅岩的貝提爾發現了一個口中塞滿電路的嬰兒。他們將他收留並撫養長大，他後來被稱為「捲曲之羔羊」Resheph，屬於貝提爾。

string.ID: At Starfarer's Quay, Resheph consulted with mysterious strangers and learned the secret of the 環流(Gyre). By cause of the misdeeds of the elder saads and sultans, star beings had levied a curse on Qud. Resheph vowed to make right from this wrong and redeem our doomed world.

strings.string: 在 星行者碼頭，Resheph 向 神秘陌生人 諮詢，並得知了 環流(Gyre) 的秘密。由於長輩 saads 與蘇丹們的惡行，星辰生物對 卡德(Qud) 降下了詛咒。Resheph 發誓要撥亂反正，救贖我們注定毀滅的世界。

string.ID: While traveling near 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa), Resheph lost control of his chariot and drove it off a cliff. Luckily, a local physician named Rebekah came to his rescue. Moved by her kindness, Resheph enrolled at a nearby hospice as her apprentice.

strings.string: 在前往 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 的途中，Resheph 失去了對戰車的控制並衝下了懸崖。幸運的是，一位名叫 Rebekah 的當地醫生前來救援。Resheph 被她的善良所感動，隨後進入附近的療養院成為她的學徒。

string.ID: In %=year=%, the 環流(Gyre) widened, and the final plague afflicted the land. The Girsh Nephilim rose from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slouched toward Qud to eat its young. Resheph rose to meet them in battle and cast them back.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，環流擴張，最後一場瘟疫襲擊了這片土地。吉爾什尼菲林從他們位於月之階梯的搖籃中起身，向卡德緩步走去，企圖吞噬其幼崽。瑞舍夫挺身而出與之交戰，並將他們擊退。

string.ID: At twilight in the shadow of the 紡錘(Spindle), the people of 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) saw an image on the horizon that looked like a ghost bathed in cerulean. It was Resheph, and after he came and left 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch), the people built a monument to him, and thenceforth called him Ghost-in-Cerulean.

strings.string: 在紡錘的陰影下的黃昏時分，歐蒙波奇的人民在天際線看到了一個看起來像是沐浴在蔚藍中的幽靈影像。那是雷舍夫（Resheph），在他來到並離開歐蒙波奇之後，人們為他建造了一座紀念碑，從此稱他為「蔚藍之幽靈」。

string.ID: Your psychic glimmer represents how noticeable you are in the vast psychic aether. As your mental mutations increase in level, so does your psychic glimmer and the frequency, strength, and number of those who desire to absorb your mind.

strings.string: 你的靈能微光代表你在廣闊的靈能乙太中有多麼顯眼。隨著你的精神突變等級提升，你的靈能微光也會隨之增強，且渴望吸收你心智的人數、頻率與強度也會隨之增加。

string.ID: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by ospreys, 普托(Ptoh)'s servants and birds of psychic prey who pluck larval espers from their egg sacs.

strings.string: 目前，你正受到魚鷹、普托的僕從以及鳥類精神獵物的監視與追捕，這些獵物會從卵囊中啄食幼小的感應者。

string.ID: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by harriers, 普托(Ptoh)'s servants and birds of psychic prey who pluck fledgling espers from the shallows.

strings.string: 目前，你正受到騷擾者的監視與追捕，他們是普托的僕從，也是那些在淺灘中攫取初生心靈感應者的鳥類精神獵物。

string.ID: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by owls, 普托(Ptoh)'s servants and birds of psychic prey who snatch espers from the nighted weald.

strings.string: 目前，你正受到貓頭鷹、普托的 僕人 以及 鳥 等心靈獵物的監視與追捕，他們會從漆黑的森林中掠走靈媒。

string.ID: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by condors, 普托(Ptoh)'s servants and birds of psychic prey who snatch thriving espers from the vast wood.

strings.string: 目前，你正受到禿鷹、普托的僕從以及那些在廣袤森林中獵捕強大靈能者的鳥類精神獵物的監視與追逐。

string.ID: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by strixes, 普托(Ptoh)'s servants and birds of psychic prey who drink the blood of mature espers.

strings.string: 目前，你正受到 strixes、普托的僕從以及會飲用成熟心靈感應者之血的鳥類精神獵物的監視與追捕。

string.ID: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by eagles, 普托(Ptoh)'s servants and birds of psychic prey who seize powerful espers from their roosts.

strings.string: 目前，您正受到鷹、 普托的 僕從以及會從棲息地劫走強大心靈感應者的 鳥 等精神獵物的監視與追捕。

string.ID: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by rukhs, 普托(Ptoh)'s most powerful servants and birds of psychic prey who seize masterful espers from their belfries.

strings.string: 目前，您正受到 rukhs 的監視與追捕，牠們是 普托(Ptoh) 最強大的僕從，也是一種會從鐘樓中劫走高階靈能者的 鳥 類心靈獵物。

string.ID: You are also visible to psychic beings from other dimensions.

strings.string: 其他維度的靈能生物也能看見您。

string.ID: The shomer Rainwater claims that Brightsheol is the dream of a seraph who lives atop the 紡錘(Spindle).

strings.string: shomer 雨水聲稱 布萊特希歐 是居住在 紡錘(Spindle) 之上的熾天使之夢。

string.ID: In the mystic air of Jeweled Dusk, a circle of farmers clasped hands and sheathed a vinereaper in the moistened soil. From then on, the villagers of 約帕(Joppa) were known as the people of the vine.

strings.string: 在珠寶黃昏（Jeweled Dusk）的神祕空氣中，一群農民手牽著手，將一株藤蔓收割者（vinereaper）埋入濕潤的土壤中。從那時起，約帕村民便被稱為藤蔓之民。

string.ID: Since the first festival of Ut yara Ux, the villagers of 約帕(Joppa) have feasted on warm apple matz.

strings.string: 自從第一次 Ut yara Ux 節慶以來，約帕村民就一直享用著溫熱的蘋果瑪札（apple matz）。

string.ID: Under the Beetle Moon, folks settled here to gather goods of passage for Ape Saad Oboroqoru, and so 恰庫恰(Kyakukya) was founded.

strings.string: 在甲蟲之月下，人們在此定居以收集供奉給猿王 奧博羅科魯 的過路物資，於是 恰庫恰(Kyakukya) 便由此建立。

string.ID: In 979, Nuntu, the legendary albino ape, grew tired of bludgeoning things to death and journeyed to a root-strangled place on the River Svy. There he came upon 恰庫恰(Kyakukya) and its inhabitants. The villagers of 恰庫恰(Kyakukya) asked Nuntu to employ his magisterial skills and lead the village.

strings.string: 在 979 年，傳奇白化猿恩圖厭倦了用鈍器把東西打死，於是前往斯維河畔一個被根鬚纏繞的地方。他在那裡遇到了恰庫恰及其居民。恰庫恰村民請求恩圖運用他的大師級技能來領導村莊。

string.ID: Centuries after the height of the 環流(Gyre), the svardym Goek, Mak, and Geeub met the galgal Many Eyes while languishing inside of a reef sponge. Together they founded the Yd Freehold to live out the rest of their lives.

strings.string: 在環流鼎盛時期過後的數個世紀，斯瓦迪姆 戈克、麥克與吉烏布在礁石海綿內部消沉時，遇見了加爾加爾 萬眼。他們共同建立了伊德自由領，並在那裡度過餘生。

string.ID: In 901, the villagers of the Yd Freehold and its founders abolished all forms of hierarchy from their settlement. The two pillars of civic life in the Freehold thus became anarchy and authenticity.

strings.string: 在 901 年，伊德自由領的村民及其創始人廢除了定居點內所有形式的階級制度。因此，自由領公民生活的兩大支柱變成了無政府狀態與真實性。

string.ID: =spice:quests.thanks.!random|capitalize=. Our village owes you a debt. For now, please choose a reward from our stockpile as payment for your service.

strings.string: =spice:quests.thanks.!random|capitalize=. 我們的村莊欠你一份人情。目前，請從我們的庫存中選擇一件獎勵，作為對你服務的回報。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest dialog
string.ID: They are disciples of 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum). Mostly they are Urshiib, like their mentor. Mutant albino cave bears. With quills to boot! A thousand years ago 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the heart of Qud. He has spent centuries fiddling with the tokens of antiquity in his underground workshops.

strings.string: 他們是 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 的門徒。大多與他們的導師一樣是 Urshiib。變異的白化洞穴 熊。而且還帶著 刺！一千年前，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 和他的親族跨越了 Homs Delta，進入了 卡德(Qud) 的核心。他花了幾個世紀在他的地下 工作坊 裡擺弄那些古老的代幣。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest choice
string.ID: I will take the disk to 礫門(Grit Gate) and speak with the Barathrumites.

strings.string: 我會帶著圓盤前往礫門，並與巴拉楚姆信徒交談。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest choice deny
string.ID: I must pass on this offer, for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我現在必須拒絕這個提議。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest restart dialog
string.ID:
Are you seeking more work, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Recently we came into possession of a data disk bearing a peculiar stamp and encoded with a strange signal. The signal means nothing to us, but there's a sect of tinkers called the Barathrumites who might be interested in it. They are friends to our village and often trade for the scrap we tow out of the earth. Would you carry the disk to their enclave at 礫門(Grit Gate), along the western rim of the jungle? In exchange for the delivery, you might seek an apprenticeship with them.
If you are interested, take the disk now, and travel safely.
string.Value: 你在尋找更多工作嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=？最近我們得到了一個 數據磁碟，上面印有奇特的印記並編碼著奇怪的訊號。這個訊號對我們來說毫無意義，但有一群被稱為 巴拉楚姆信徒 的 修補匠 可能會對它感興趣。他們是我們村莊的朋友，經常用我們從地底拖出的廢料與他們交易。你能把磁碟送到他們位於 礫門(Grit Gate) 的聚落嗎？那就在 叢林 西緣沿線。作為遞送的報酬，你或許可以向他們尋求學徒機會。\n\n如果你感興趣，現在就拿走磁碟，旅途平安。

string.ID:
Oh, you died. That's okay. It's a very common occurance in the world of Qud.
Because the tutorial drops you off in Classic mode with permadeath, your character is wiped when you die.
The good news is: you get to make a whole new character! Now with a little more knowledge than you had before.
string.Value:
喔，你死了。沒關係，這在卡德的世界中是非常常見的事情。
因為教學關卡是在具有永久死亡機制的經典模式下進行，所以當你死亡時，你的角色會被抹除。
好消息是：你可以創造一個全新的角色！而且這次你會比之前擁有更多的知識。

string.ID:
Next time, if you want a more forgiving mode of play, try Roleplay, which lets you checkpoint at settlements.
Or try Wander mode, where most creatures are neutral to you and you gain experience via discovery instead of killing.
Or keep playing Classic if the challenge appeals to you and you'd like to explore a breadth of character types.
string.Value:
下次如果你想要更寬容的遊戲模式，可以嘗試「角色扮演 (Roleplay)」模式，這讓你在定居點可以存檔。
或者嘗試「漫遊 (Wander)」模式，在那裡大多數生物對你都是中立的，且你可以透過探索而非殺戮來獲得經驗值。
如果你喜歡挑戰並想探索多樣的角色類型，那就繼續玩「經典 (Classic)」模式吧。

string.ID:
Whatever you choose next, feel free to return to the tutorial if you need a refresher.
Live and drink, friend!
string.Value:
無論你接下來選擇什麼，若需要複習，隨時可以回到教學模式。
盡情生活與飲酒吧，朋友！

string.ID:
On the =day= of =month=, you arrive at the oasis-hamlet of {{green|約帕(Joppa)}}, along the far rim of {{Y|莫格拉伊(Moghra'yi), the Great Salt Desert}}.
All around you, moisture farmers tend to groves of viridian watervine. There are huts wrought from rock salt and brinestalk.
On the horizon, {{r|Qud's}} jungles strangle chrome steeples and rusted archways to the earth. Further and beyond, the fabled {{C|紡錘(Spindle)}} rises above the fray and pierces the cloud-ribboned sky.
string.Value:
在 =day= 的 =month= 之際，你抵達了位於 {{Y|莫格拉伊(Moghra'yi), the Great Salt Desert}} 遠緣的綠洲村落 {{green|約帕(Joppa)}}。
在你四周，水分農民照料著一片片翠綠的 水藤 林。那裡有由 岩鹽 和 鹽莖 建造的小屋。
在地平線上，{{r|卡德的}} 叢林將鉻合金尖塔與 生鏽的拱門 勒入大地。更遠處，傳說中的 {{C|紡錘(Spindle)}} 聳立於紛擾之上，刺破了雲帶繚繞的天空。

string.ID:
On the =day= of =month=, you arrive at the village of {{g|=state.string:villageZeroName=}}.
On the horizon, {{r|Qud's}} jungles strangle chrome steeples and rusted archways to the earth. Further and beyond, the fabled {{C|紡錘(Spindle)}} rises above the fray and pierces the cloud-ribboned sky.
string.Value:
在 =month= 的 =day= 上，你抵達了 {{g|=state.string:villageZeroName=}} 村。
在地平線上，{{r|卡德的}} 叢林纏繞著鉻鋼尖塔與生鏽的拱門，緊貼大地。更遠處，傳說中的 {{C|紡錘(Spindle)}} 從紛亂中聳立而出，刺穿了雲帶繚繞的天空。

string.ID: On the =day= of =month=, you arrived at =villageName=.
On the auspicious =day= of =month=, =player.name= arrived in =villageName= and began =player.their= prodigious odyssey through Qud.

strings.string: 在 =month= 的吉祥 =day= 之日，=player.name= 抵達了 =villageName=，並開始了他在 Qud 之中 =player.their= 的壯麗奧德賽。

string.ID: At =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random= under =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random|article= and =color= sky, the people of =villageName= saw an image on the horizon that looked like =elementNoun|article= bathed in =color=. It was =player.name=, and after =player.subjective= came and left, the people of =villageName= built a monument to =name= and thenceforth called =player.objective= =elementNoun|title=-in-=color|title=.

strings.string: 在 =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random|article= 與 =color= 之空的 =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random= 之下，=villageName= 的人們在天際線看到了一幅景象，看起來像是沐浴在 =color= 中的 =elementNoun|article=。那是 =player.name=，而在 =player.subjective= 來去之後，=villageName= 的人們為 =name= 建造了一座紀念碑，從此以後便稱 =player.objective= 為 =elementNoun|title=-in-=color|title=。

string.ID: The chuppah of Qas and Qon
I found a bloody patch of fur near the village paths, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我在村莊小徑附近發現了一簇毛皮，沾滿了血跡，這是近期發生暴力事件的徵兆。

string.ID: Is that a patch of hindren fur? There's blood on it...
string.Value: 那是希德倫的皮毛嗎？上面還有血跡……

string.ID: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我發現了一叢被鮮血染紅的 {{color:red|一叢水藤}}，這是近期發生暴力事件的跡象。

string.ID: How odd, this watervine is stained red with blood.
string.Value: 真奇怪，這株 水藤 被鮮血染紅了。

string.ID: I found a weapon haft, broken from use, on the paths, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我在小徑上發現了一截因使用而斷裂的武器柄，這是近期發生暴力事件的徵兆。

string.ID: How odd, the broken haft of a weapon, a sign of recent violence.
string.Value: 真奇怪，武器的柄斷了，這是近期發生暴力的跡象。

string.ID: Someone left a sealed merchant's waterskin on the paths, a sign of recent trade.

strings.string: 有人在小徑上留下了一個密封的商人水囊，這是近期有貿易往來的徵兆。

string.ID: Hmm, this waterskin is still sealed with wax.
string.Value: 嗯，這個水囊仍用蠟封著。

string.ID: Someone dropped a copper nugget on the paths, a sign of recent trade.

strings.string: 有人在小徑上掉落了一塊銅塊，顯示近期曾有貿易活動。

string.ID: How odd, there's a copper nugget just lying on the ground.
string.Value: 真奇怪，地上就這樣躺著一塊銅塊。

string.ID: I discovered a footprint from a great saltback on the paths, a sign of recent trade.

strings.string: 我在小徑上發現了大鹽背獸的足跡，這是近期有貿易往來的跡象。

string.Value: 那真是個巨大的足跡。

string.ID: I found a detached tongue on the ground, rotted with infection: a sign of recent illness.

strings.string: 我在地上發現了一條脫落的舌頭，因感染而腐爛：這是近期患病的跡象。

string.ID: Oh gross, there's a rotten tongue on the ground!
string.Value: 噢真噁心，地上有一條腐爛的舌頭！

string.ID: I found the discarded husks of the curative yuckwheat plant, a sign of recent illness.

strings.string: 我發現了被丟棄的「惡臭麥」植株殘骸，這顯示近期曾有疾病發生。

string.ID: How odd, some discarded chaff from a yuckwheat plant.
string.Value: 真奇怪，是一些從 惡臭麥 植物上丟棄的碎屑。

string.ID: I found a few scraps from some kind of leatherworking project, a sign of recent craft.

strings.string: 我發現了一些某種皮革製作工程的碎料，這顯示近期曾有人進行手工藝活動。

string.ID: How odd, someone dropped some scraps of cut leather here.
string.Value: 真奇怪，有人在這裡丟了一些皮革碎屑。

string.ID: Someone discarded a worn but still functional leather bracer on the paths, a sign of recent craft.

strings.string: 有人在小徑上丟棄了一個磨損但仍可使用的 皮革護腕，顯示近期有工藝活動。

string.ID: This leather bracer has seen some use. Why is it out here?
string.Value: 這件 皮革護腕 看起來用過不少次。為什麼它會在這裡？

string.ID: I found a small leatherworking hammer on the paths, a sign of recent craft.

strings.string: 我在小徑上發現了一把小小的 皮革加工錘，顯示這裡最近有人進行過手工藝。

string.ID: Someone has left a small hammer on the path.
string.Value: 有人在路上留下了一把小錘子。

string.ID: One villager was frightened by sounds of fighting at night, indicating recent violence.

strings.string: 一名村民被夜晚的戰鬥聲嚇到了，顯示近期發生過暴力事件。

string.ID: I heard the sounds of fighting the other night! I stayed in the next day, so afeared was I.

strings.string: 前幾天晚上我聽到了戰鬥聲！我隔天都待在室內不敢出來，真是嚇壞了。

string.ID: One of 貝拉(Bey Lah)'s scouts heard a fight in the watervine paddies, indicating recent violence.

strings.string: 一名 貝拉(Bey Lah) 的偵查兵在 水藤 田地中聽到了戰鬥聲，顯示近期發生過暴力事件。

string.ID: I thought I heard splashing from a fight in the marsh grids, but I couldn't find anyone.

strings.string: 我以為我聽到沼澤格點的戰鬥傳來濺水聲，但我找不到任何人。

string.ID: Faundren saw a merchant from outside the village sneaking around, indicating recent trade.

strings.string: Faundren 看見一名來自村外的商人正在鬼鬼祟祟地徘徊，顯示近期有貿易往來。

string.ID: I saw a kendren merchant the other day! They were being very sneaky, so I think they were meeting someone in secret! Isn't that interesting?

strings.string: 我前幾天看到一個肯德倫（kendren）商人！他們表現得很鬼鬼祟祟，所以我認為他們正在秘密會見某人！這不是很有趣嗎？

string.ID: The faundren heard the voice of a hindren and a kendren discussing goods late at night, indicating recent trade.

strings.string: 這位 faundren 在深夜聽見了一位 hindren 與一位 kendren 在討論貨物，顯示近期有貿易往來。

string.ID: I heard a hindren talking about buying and selling to a kendren late at night! I thought that all kendren had to report to Grand-Doe?

strings.string: 我聽到一群 hindren 在深夜裡討論要向 kendren 買賣東西！我以為所有的 kendren 都必須向 Grand-Doe 報告？

string.ID: The villagers are on edge due to rumors of sore throats in the village, indicating recent illness.

strings.string: 由於村內傳出喉嚨痛的謠言，村民們感到惶惶不安，這顯示近期有疾病流行。

string.ID: I heard that someone in the village might have a sore throat, so I am staying at least ten handspan away from everyone today.

strings.string: 我聽說村子裡有人喉嚨痛，所以我今天會與每個人保持至少十手掌的距離。

string.ID: The faundren are complaining about the smell of yuckwheat tea, indicating recent illness.

strings.string: faundren 正在抱怨惡臭麥茶的味道，顯示近期有疾病流行。

string.ID: I smelled yuckwheat tea the other day! That smell is so terrible! Is someone sick?

strings.string: 我前幾天聞到了惡臭麥茶的味道！那味道真難聞！是有人生病了嗎？

string.ID: The scouts report that someone has taken leather from the village stores, indicating recent craft.

strings.string: 偵查兵報告有人從 村莊商店 拿走了皮革，顯示近期有工藝活動。

string.ID: I went to do some repairs to my boots, but someone's been in our stores of boar leather! We have far less than we should.

strings.string: 我本想去修理我的 靴子，但有人闖進了我們的野豬皮儲藏室！我們的存貨比應有的少得多。

string.ID: The scouts heard someone doing work with tools late at night, indicating recent craft.

strings.string: 偵查兵聽到深夜有人在使用工具工作，顯示近期曾有人進行手工藝活動。

string.ID: I heard someone doing some kind of toolwork during a night watch shift. I didn't interrupt, but it seemed peculiar.

strings.string: 我聽說有人在值夜班時在做某種工具製作。我沒有打擾，但那看起來很奇特。

string.ID: I found an empty injector near the 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)'s bedroll. Why doesn't anyone know she was sick?

strings.string: 我在欣德里亞克的 睡袋 附近發現了一個空的注射器。為什麼沒人知道她生病了？

string.ID: Hmm. This injector has been used.
string.Value: 嗯。這個注射器已經用過了。

string.ID: I found a bloody arrow on the paths of 貝拉(Bey Lah). Its fletching resembles the ones in 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Keh's quiver.

strings.string: 我在 貝拉(Bey Lah) 的路徑上發現了一支帶血的箭。它的羽毛看起來很像 希德里亞克·凱 的箭袋裡的箭。

string.ID: Why, this arrow is covered with blood!
string.Value: 天啊，這支箭沾滿了血！

string.ID: Apparently, the 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) isolated herself to work on a mystery project, possibly to hide Kindrish.

strings.string: 顯然，欣德里亞克為了進行一項神秘計畫而自我隔離，可能是為了隱藏 Kindrish。

string.ID: You know, Grand-Doe spent some late nights working on something she wouldn't talk about. I wonder what that was.

strings.string: 你知道嗎，大鹿（Grand-Doe）曾熬夜在做一些她不願提及的事情。我很好奇那究竟是什麼。

string.ID: Rumor has it that the village is flush with water, perhaps because Keh made a big trade.

strings.string: 傳聞說村子裡水資源充足，或許是因為 Keh 進行了一筆大交易。

string.ID: By the Eaters, how prosperous we've been. I've never seen the village so flush with fresh water.

strings.string: 以噬者之名，我們是多麼繁榮。我從未見過村莊有如此充足的淡水。

string.ID: The faundren claim that Eskhind left the village sporting a poorly-made leather bracer, possibly to conceal Kindrish.

strings.string: faundren 聲稱 艾斯金德 離開村莊時戴著一個做工粗糙的 皮革護腕，可能是為了隱藏 Kindrish。

string.ID: Just before auntie Eskhind left the village, I saw her wearing a new bracer. It looked terrible!

strings.string: 就在艾斯金德阿姨離開村莊前，我看到她戴著一個新的護腕。看起來糟透了！

string.ID: The faundren tell me that Eskhind's sister had a period of complete silence; she may have been ill.

strings.string: faundren 告訴我，艾斯金德的姊姊曾有一段完全沉默的時期；她當時可能生病了。

string.ID: You know auntie Eskhind's little sister, Liihart? She's always been quiet, but she didn't talk at all for, uh, two whole weeks before they left!

strings.string: 妳知道艾斯金德阿姨的小妹妹利哈特嗎？她一直都很安靜，但在她們離開前的，呃，整整兩週內，她完全沒有說過話！

string.ID: I found the village stores of 貝拉(Bey Lah) untouched; Eskhind must have traded something for her basics.

strings.string: 我發現 貝拉(Bey Lah) 的 村莊商店 未受損壞；艾斯金德 一定是用某樣東西換取了她的生活必需品。

string.ID: Whoever stole Kindrish didn't steal from the village stores. These chests are simply packed with dried lah, vinewafers, and waterskins.

strings.string: 偷走 Kindrish 的人並沒有偷取 村莊商店 的東西。這些箱子裡裝滿了乾燥的 lah、藤蔓薄餅 和 水囊。

string.ID: Eskhind is showing signs of a leg injury. Perhaps she was in a fight.
string.Value: 艾斯金德 有腿部受傷的跡象。或許她剛經歷了一場戰鬥。

string.ID: Eskhind appears to be favoring a leg, though she has concealed any injury.
string.Value: 艾斯金德 似乎在偏袒一條腿，儘管她隱藏了任何傷勢。

strings.string: 艾斯金德正在偏愛一條腿。

string.ID: The faundren tell me that Kesehind went quiet for a few weeks, only to become louder than ever again.

strings.string: faundren 告訴我，凱塞欣德 曾沉寂了幾週，接著卻變得比以往更加喧囂。

string.ID: For weeks and weeks, Kesehind was so quiet, but now he's talking more than ever! He's so loud!

strings.string: 好幾個禮拜以來，凱塞欣德 都非常安靜，但現在他講話比以往任何時候都還要多！他聲音真大！

string.ID: Rumor has it that Kesehind has always worn hand-me-down armor, but he was recently seen with a brand new set.

strings.string: 傳聞說 凱塞欣德 一直都穿著別人穿剩的舊盔甲，但最近有人看到他換上了一套全新的裝備。

string.ID: Did you see Kesehind's armor? He always used to wear hand-me-downs from the scouts, but what he's wearing now looks brand new!

strings.string: 你有看到凱塞欣德的護甲嗎？他以前總是穿著偵察兵傳下來的舊衣物，但他現在穿的看起來跟新的一樣！

string.ID: I found a worn-out bracer abandoned near Kesehind's bedroll.

strings.string: 我在 凱塞欣德的 睡袋 附近發現了一個磨損的護腕。

string.ID: That's strange. This bracer is heavily worn, but surprisingly clean.
string.Value: 真奇怪。這款護腕磨損得很嚴重，但卻出奇地乾淨。

string.ID: Kesehind tried to clean blood off his armor, but missed a spot.
string.Value: 凱塞欣德試圖清理盔甲上的血跡，但漏掉了一個地方。

string.ID: Carmine streaks on Kesehind's armor suggest that he tried and failed to wipe away spilled blood.
string.Value: 凱塞欣德的護甲上有著緋紅色的條紋，顯示他曾試圖擦拭濺出的血跡但失敗了。

string.ID: Kesehind's armor has bloodstains that he failed to remove.
string.Value: 凱塞欣德的 armor 上有他未能清除的血跡。

string.ID: The 貝拉(Bey Lah) scouts have had trouble with violent kendren. What if one slipped by?

strings.string: 貝拉偵察兵一直受到暴力肯德倫的困擾。如果其中一個溜過去了怎麼辦？

string.ID: The kendren are becoming more brazen in their hostility. I've had to misdirect and fight them off several times this month alone.

strings.string: 肯德倫人（kendren）的敵意變得愈發囂張。光是這個月，我就不得不好幾次誤導並擊退他們。

string.ID: The scouts have seen kendren treasure hunters about. That type will take anything not nailed down.

strings.string: 偵察兵看到附近有肯德倫（kendren）寶藏獵人出沒。那種傢伙只要不是釘死的，什麼都會偷走。

string.ID: I came across some kendren who claimed to be treasure hunters. They said that they would pay good water for unique artifacts or treasures.

strings.string: 我遇到了一些自稱是尋寶者的肯德倫人。他們說只要是獨特的文物或寶藏，他們願意支付優渥的水資源作為報酬。

string.ID: Theft by kendren is very common during an outbreak of disease like the one the villagers describe.

strings.string: 在村民所描述的這種疾病爆發期間，肯德倫的盜竊行為非常普遍。

string.ID: I've heard that there is an outbreak of glotrot in the kendren villages outside of 貝拉(Bey Lah). Now I want to leave here even less!

strings.string: 我聽說在 貝拉(Bey Lah) 外面的 肯德倫村落發生了黏液腐爛症的爆發。現在我更不想離開這裡了！

string.ID: I found a set of foreign leatherworking tools on the village paths. A kendren crafter has been here.

strings.string: 我在村莊小徑上發現了一套外國的皮革加工工具。有個肯德倫工匠曾在此停留。

string.ID: This set of leatherworking tools is shockingly well-made.
string.Value: 這套 皮革加工工具 做工精良得令人震驚。

string.Context: PopTableZoneBuilder - Apply Zone Faction - DisplayName Adjective for faction swap
SultanDungeon - Member Of Social Role Display Name
SultanDungeon - Member Of Social Role Display Name
Children of the Tomb Accomplishment - Text
string.ID: You restored functionality to one of the four strange entities in the Tomb.

strings.string: 你恢復了墳墓中四個奇異實體之一的功能。

string.Context: Children of the Tomb Accomplishment - mural text
string.ID: Remember the kindness of =name=, who absolved =player.possessive= treacherous brother of sin and steered him to salvation!

strings.string: 銘記 =name= 的仁慈吧，他赦免了 =player.possessive= 背信棄義之兄的罪孽，並引領他走向救贖！

string.Context: Children of the Tomb Accomplishment - gospel text
string.ID: In a moss-caked tomb under the light of the 紡錘(Spindle), =name= cemented their relationship with enigmatic beings by marrying the entity =entityName=.

strings.string: 在紡錘的光芒下，一座佈滿苔蘚的墳墓中，=name= 與神祕生物 =entityName= 結為連理，鞏固了彼此的關係。

string.Context: Village apothecary conversation intro low tier
string.ID: I've the cure for what ails you.~You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.~Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.~"Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: 我有治癒你病痛的方法.~你看起來不太妙。你的飲食中需要攝取更多惡臭麥和蜂蜜.~如果你感到不適，請用惡臭麥烹飪食物。及早發現疾病，你就能消滅它.~「緩解痛苦，混淆大腦。」咀嚼女巫木皮時要小心。

string.ID: I've the cure for what ails you.~You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.~Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.~"Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.~In the market for a tonic, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Spend water now or blood later, your choice.~Prickly-boons and yuckwheat for trade.~If you came for the humble pie, you had best not have led any mind-hunters here.~Have you got enough tonics?

strings.string: 我有能治好你病痛的藥方.~你看起來不太妙。你的飲食中需要攝取更多惡臭麥和蜂蜜.~如果你感到不適，請用惡臭麥烹飪食物。只要在疾病初期發現，就能將其消滅.~「緩解痛苦，混淆大腦。」咀嚼女巫木皮時要小心.~正在尋找補藥嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=? 現在花錢，以後就得流血，由你選擇.~用刺果與惡臭麥來交易.~如果你是為了謙卑派而來，最好別帶任何心靈獵人到這裡.~你的補藥夠嗎？
